title: Coming Home to the Body
summary: A four-day solo retreat in the mountains for reconnecting with your own body through breath, movement, and unhurried stillness.
description: Set among pine forests at 6,000 feet, this retreat unplugs you from noise and returns you to a slower rhythm. Days move through guided embodiment practices, mindful walks, and afternoons of unstructured quiet — no partner, no audience, just you and your breath. Evenings close with sound baths led by Sana. No phones, no agenda beyond presence.

title: The Art of Presence
summary: A weekend for couples and partners to slow down, drop into breath, and rediscover each other through conscious touch and presence practices.
description: A week built around daily partner practice — breathwork, eye gazing, and conscious touch — bookended by long stretches of free time to swim, wander the cliffs, or simply rest together. Theo's kitchen anchors the days with three seasonal meals, and the group gathers each evening for open conversation.

title: Somatic Reset Weekend
summary: A two-day intensive in conscious touch, cold exposure, and nervous-system regulation.
description: Marcus leads small-group sessions on releasing chronic tension through somatic movement, conscious touch practices, and breath-led cold immersion. Designed for people who want tools they can keep using long after the weekend ends.

title: Desert New Moon Gathering
summary: A three-night gathering under open desert sky, built around sound healing, energy work, and communal ritual.
description: Timed to the new moon, this small gathering moves between sound baths, energy work, and long silences under an unusually dark sky. Tents and shared meals only — no phones, no schedules beyond sunrise and sunset.

title: Kitchen & Craft Immersion
summary: A five-day retreat centered on seasonal cooking, sensory ritual, and slow mornings in the countryside.
description: Spend your days in Theo's outdoor kitchen learning fermentation, bread, and forest foraging, balanced with gentle morning movement and long unstructured afternoons. Every meal is treated as its own sensory practice. Ends with a communal harvest dinner for the whole group.

title: Sacred Union
summary: A ceremonial weekend for couples ready to deepen intimacy — blending ritual, breath, and guided touch practices in a small, private group.
description: Held over Valentine's weekend in the rice terraces above Ubud, Sacred Union is built for couples ready to slow down together. Days move through partner breathwork, guided touch, and closing ceremony led by Elena and Sana — in a deliberately small, private group so nothing feels performed.
